item.description:
Recognize what a warning was about

  • A compact “What was checked” card below the score shows the original app, capture time, a short text excerpt and relevant link destinations.
  • Excerpts stay with their own check, so a delayed result still refers to the message or page that was checked. When possible, findings help choose the relevant passage.
  • New local-only checks can keep a brief filtered excerpt in encrypted history. Saved exclusions and text filters still apply. Link credentials, query strings and fragments are omitted from this reminder.
  • Older online checks can use their saved submitted text. Older local checks without retained content show that an excerpt is unavailable.

No new capture, permission or online request is added. Excerpts appear inside DITT; notification content, warning thresholds and scores are unchanged.
